parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$P(X>2)=1-\sum_{x=0}^{2}\binom7x(0.18)^x(0.82)^{7-x}$. [M1]
Guidance: Use a binomial term $\binom7x p^x(1-p)^{7-x}$ with a valid probability and success count.
$P(X>2)=1-(0.249285+0.383048+0.252251)=1-0.88458$. [A1]
Guidance: Correct unsimplified complement expression or better; omission of brackets is allowed if recovered.
$P(X>2)=0.115$. [B1]
Guidance: Accept values from $0.115$ up to but not including $0.1155$, provided they are not obtained from wrong working.
Total: 3

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$P(\text{at least one rainy day})=1-(0.82)^7=0.7507$. [B1]
Guidance: Accept a one-period probability rounding to $0.751$.
$P(\text{exactly two periods})=\binom32(0.7507)^2(1-0.7507)$. [M1]
Guidance: Follow through the identified one-period probability, but not the daily values $0.18$ or $0.82$; accept an equivalent factor of 3 and condone a factor of 2 for the method mark.
$P(\text{exactly two periods})=0.421$. [A1]
Guidance: Accept values from $0.421$ to $0.4215$ inclusive; special-case B1 is available for this final value if no earlier marks score.
Total: 3
